About the job

One of our client is looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to bring ideas to life through strong visual design. If you have a good eye for aesthetics, enjoy experimenting with ideas, and can take a design from concept to final output independently, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Location: Remote
  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Up to ₹35,000/month
  • Experience: Fresher to Junior Level
  • Joining: Immediate to 30 days preferred

What You’ll Work On

  • Create engaging graphics and visual content across different requirements.
  • Develop creative concepts based on briefs.
  • Design social media creatives, marketing materials and other visual assets.
  • Take ownership of designs from ideation to final execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially Photoshop and Illustrator; knowledge of Premiere Pro is an added advantage.
  • Good understanding of typography, layouts and colour combinations.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing design skills, creative thinking and ideation.

Hiring Process

The selection process will include 4 stages:

  • Screening Round
  • HR Round
  • Design Assignment
  • Founder's Round
